reclaim_schedule: COMPRESSED: charged when a page's wire bytes are read; released the instant that page is decompressed (per page, never accumulates).
ARENA: charged in <=arena_chunk steps as the page expands; unused chunk slack returned immediately; nets to zero once the page is decompressed and transferred to the batch.
PENDING_PAGES: owns each decoded page until the batch is validated; moved (not freed) onward after validation.
INDEX_QUEUE: owns all pages of a validated batch through indexing and commit; released right after the COMMIT pointer is durable and the batch is published to the index.
RETRY_HELD: owns a validated batch's pages across a transient commit failure and its backoff; returned to INDEX_QUEUE after the retry and released to zero once the batch finally commits or fails.

two_producers_concurrent.note: both producers can each hold one compressed page and one arena chunk at the same instant; budget counts them independently
